title: Bell with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell body - golden yellow -->
  <path d='M50 12 C50 12, 30 14, 26 40 L22 68 C22 68, 20 78, 34 78 L66 78 C80 78, 78 68, 78 68 L74 40 C70 14, 50 12, 50 12 Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Bell shine/highlight -->
  <path d='M38 22 C36 30, 34 44, 33 56 L31 66 C31 66, 33 70, 38 70 L38 70 C36 60, 37 44, 40 28 Z' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <!-- Bell rim/base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='7' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='26' ry='7' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- Bell top handle/loop -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#E6A800' stroke-width='4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#FFC107' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Clapper -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='6' fill='#CC8800'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='85' r='4' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- Eyes - big and friendly -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#5C3D00'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#5C3D00'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='56' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M40 60 Q50 72, 60 60' fill='none' stroke='#5C3D00' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
